description: This file declares the DataReaderFactory class which implements the IDataReaderFactory interface. It provides a method to create data reader instances based on media source type and buffer parameters.

classes.name: DataReaderFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating IDataReader instances based on media source type and buffer parameters.

methods.name: createDataReader
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IDataReader object, configured with the specified media source type, buffer, data offset, and number of frames.
